name: algebra-two
description: Factor, locate roots and inspect sequences.

interface.longDescription: Factor, locate roots and inspect sequences. Includes a launch screen, side-panel workspace, editable input controls and real computations: Solve ax² + bx + c = 0; Evaluate a polynomial; Build a geometric sequence. Imports and exports its own versioned documents. Uses supplied information; no live lookup or background monitoring.
defaultPrompt: Help me solve ax² + bx + c = 0.

prompts: Help me solve ax² + bx + c = 0.
Help me build a geometric sequence.

positive.description: Open the launch screen without calculating.
positive.expected_behavior: Returns the actual launch screen with three distinct workflow cards. No computation or file access.

positive.prompt: Open the Root & Ratio: Algebra II workspace beside this chat.
positive.expected_behavior: Returns the editable workspace and labeled illustrative inputs. No computation starts automatically.

positive.description: Solve ax² + bx + c = 0. Reproducible inputs: {"a":1,"b":-5,"c":6}
positive.prompt: Help me solve ax² + bx + c = 0 with these supplied values: {"a":1,"b":-5,"c":6}
positive.expected_behavior: Uses algebra_two_quadratic_roots with the supplied inputs. Returns {"discriminant":1,"roots":[3,2],"complex":null,"vertex":{"x":2.5,"y":-0.25}}. Shows the actual plot result. Does not fabricate external data.

positive.prompt: Help me evaluate a polynomial with these supplied values: {"coefficients":[2,-3,0,5],"x":2}
positive.expected_behavior: Uses algebra_two_polynomial_value with the supplied inputs. Returns {"value":9,"steps":[{"coefficient":2,"accumulator":2},{"coefficient":-3,"accumulator":1},{"coefficient":0,"accumulator":2},{"coefficient":5,"accumulator":9}],"method":"Horner evaluation"}. Shows the actual equation result. Does not fabricate external data.

positive.description: Build a geometric sequence. Reproducible inputs: {"first":3,"ratio":2,"count":8}
positive.prompt: Help me build a geometric sequence with these supplied values: {"first":3,"ratio":2,"count":8}
positive.expected_behavior: Uses algebra_two_geometric_sequence with the supplied inputs. Returns {"terms":[3,6,12,24,48,96,192,384],"sum":765}. Shows the actual sequence result. Does not fabricate external data.
